summary: No held thesis is broken by evidence in the files. The fundamentals menu (as of 2026-10-27) still shows every held operating name passing: DPZ F8 with cfo $792M vs net income $602M, IDXX F8 with cfo $1,182M vs net income $1,059M, CARG F8 with cfo $295M vs net income $156M, VRSN F9, MSM F9, MSCI F8, FAST F8 (cfo $1,296M vs net income $1,258M, thin), WMT F7 and KR F7 with cfo above net income, and none carries a flag. IDXX is +20.5% on the fill after the 11-02 print (PM reasoning cites a beat and raise), which resolves the stale 'earnings outside the window' premise in its favor. DPZ (+1.6% on fill), WMT (+7.7%), CARG (+7.6%), MSCI (+5.3%), KR (+4.9%) and VRSN (+4.5%) are green or flat; BTC/USD (-8.4%, close.json) and VOO/VTI (about -1.8% to -1.9%) are down but within their stops, and those three are not fundamentals-screen names. Caveat: the menu predates the Q3 prints for VRSN, MSCI, MSM and IDXX, so those cash-flow figures are the prior fiscal year and have not been re-tested.
update: (1) DPZ: the fundamentals leg of the thesis holds (menu F8, cfo above net income, no flags), and the price leg is nowhere near tripped (market value implies about $321 against a $316.58 fill). The written invalidation of $274.88 is still anchored to the $305.42 reference close and sits about 13% under the fill. The PM's 11-02 reasoning re-anchors it to about $285 (L1/L5), which I agree with. The 10-30 aggregator item on a lowered store-opening and operating-income outlook is not backed by any 8-K in the files, so it is not evidence of a break; treat it as a watch item. The Staples label is a wholesale-groceries SIC artifact, so DPZ's gp_sector_pct of 1.0 overstates its rank, and the thesis already rests on absolute quality. (2) CARG: the negative-surprise clause is live ahead of the 11-05 after-close report; the menu fundamentals (gp 1.27, cfo about 1.9x net income) are intact, but current_ratio_improved is false and the name sits near the vol cutoff (0.399 vs 0.44). (3) FAST: cash conversion is only about 1.03x and gross_margin_improved is false, so a weak print would trip its clause quickly; no evidence of that yet. (4) Menu staleness: ask for a fundamentals refresh after the Q3 filings (VRSN, MSCI, MSM, IDXX reported 10-20 to 10-22 or 11-02), because the menu's fiscal-year data cannot confirm or break any thesis written around those prints. (5) Holdings off the menu (BND, IEF, VOO, VTI, BTC/USD) are ETFs or crypto with no SEC metrics; I have no fundamentals view and none of their invalidations is a fundamentals matter.
